body.statement: Can the Rademacher-partition exponential-Hermite handle construct \(\Pi_{G,n}\) and \(\Pi_{N,n}\), supported on primitive laws in \(\mathcal G_n\) and \(\mathcal N_n(\delta_n)\), together with common fixed supplied fits in the corresponding \(\mathcal H_n(P)\), so that the projected evaluation mixtures have uniformly bounded chi-square distance, hide a fourth-cumulant signal of order \(s_n\), and separate \(\theta_0\) by order \(d_n^-\) for \(\delta_n\lesssim s_n\) and by order \(\min\{d_n^-,B_n/\delta_n\}\) for \(\delta_n/s_n\to\infty\)?
body.justification: This is the load-bearing construction for the branch-designated converse.
body.gap: Existing Hermite-mixture bounds do not enforce the exact PLM law, residual independence, primitive-law support, and common supplied-fit budgets in the same projected experiment.
body.consumer: A successful pair gives the sharp benchmark for diagnostics-driven causal intervals.
